relationships.subject: DNMT1
relationships.evidence_quote: Nerve injury increases DNMT1 in DRG neurons through CREB-dependent signaling, promotes methylation of the Kcna2 promoter and 5′ untranslated region, reduces Kv1.2 expression and potassium current, and increases neuronal excitability

relationships.subject: Dnmt3a2
relationships.evidence_quote: In CFA-induced inflammatory pain, dorsal-horn Dnmt3a2 increased, and knockdown reduced Ptgs2/Cox-2 induction and prevented long-lasting hypersensitivity

relationships.subject: TET1
relationships.evidence_quote: TET1-dependent conversion of 5-methylcytosine to 5-hydroxymethylcytosine at the Bdnf promoter similarly increases BDNF in dorsal-horn neurons

relationships.subject: EZH2
relationships.evidence_quote: EZH2, which catalyzes H3K27 methylation, promotes spinal neuroinflammation and pain in part through repression of regulatory programs

key_findings: Review: chronic-pain epigenetic changes are locus-, cell- and stage-specific; hypermethylation can silence anti-nociceptive genes (Kcna2) while demethylation activates pro-nociceptive genes (Bdnf, Cxcr3).
Broad DNMT/HDAC inhibitors show analgesia mainly in animals; HDAC6 inhibitor ricolinostat failed in phase 2.
